◈ FLASHBACK — Dog tags
Not yours. Mikhail's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Mikhail would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.

◈ "UNIT TOTE BAG — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. C

◈ FLASHBACK — Tote Bag
Thirty-one years of bus routes in this canvas. The driver on the 42 used to wait when he saw you running — all those years, he waited. You never learned his name. You think abou
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
◈ THE CREEP — Vasilisa's thoughts have an echo now. The System's echo. Or theirs. Hard to tell anymore. Gifts used in sequence resonate — try them together. (Ability slots: 5)
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+3 integration)
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
◈ HAVEN — The easy closeness has thinned a little. Nobody's fault. Weather changes.
◈ THE GRANT — full integration. The System opens the last slot like a door it built just for Vasilisa. "You have been adequate entertainment. We upgrade adequate." (Ability slots: 6)
◈ FULL INTEGRATION — you don't look AT the System anymore. You look WITH it.
◈ The Records: the Bearer won a contest under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrot
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Sofia — Field 1. Three offers; they took Bird Whisperer. Earned, chosen. (bird_whisperer: villager level-up)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Stonebridge bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Kathleen speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST

◈ SYSTEM: "FIRST CONTACT, people! Do you KNOW what this is? This is the PILOT for a whole new SHOW. Two fires! One story! The cameras are already fighting over angles — smile, little fires, you're SOM
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Kathleen speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ You understand now: that wasn't human. That was Wren — Student, Vexari Exchange Program — wearing a person like a suit. (you spotted her leaving a cache)
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Mei.
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Kathleen speaks at The Hungry Road's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does F
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Rebecca is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.
◈ CRISIS — THE HUNGER WINTER. Three days now the village has gone to sleep hungry. The pantry is an echo. This is the part the old stories skip — the part where you find out what you’re made of.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
◈ LEVEL UP — STRANGE 1. "We've been counting: 18 brushes with the System. Pick one."
